muc_tieu: Mo phong quy dao gap-tha bac 5 va so sanh PID thuan voi PID + feed-forward cho robot Delta 3-DOF

trajectory.boundary_conditions: dung han tai moi diem: v=0, a=0

joint_model.cross_coupling: bo qua tuong tac cheo giua 3 khop (giai thiet tach khop)

giathieu: Khop quay duoc mo hinh hoa nhu 3 he quan tinh-nhot doc lap, bo qua trong luc va tuong tac dong hoc cheo.
Quy dao thao tac duoc tinh trong khong gian thao tac, sau do chuyen sang khong gian khop qua IK de dieu khien.
Feed-forward = J*theta_ddot_ref + b*theta_dot_ref, bu tru quan tinh va ma sat nhot.
Sai so bam duoc quy doi ve khong gian thao tac bang FK voi goc khop thuc te.
Chu ky chuyen dong thuan = tong thoi gian 3 doan quy dao bac 5, chua tinh thoi gian dinh vi cho xi-lanh kep tha.
notes: Day la mo phong ly thuyet; tham so J, b, tau_max, omega_max la gia dinh tham chieu, se chot theo BOM dong co / bo truyen.
Bo qua do tre truyen thong, tre xu ly hinh anh va thoi gian kep tha vat trong chu ky thuan.
